newsitem.title: UK: Major says Britain set for sustained growth.
newsitem.headline: Major says Britain set for sustained growth.

text.p: Prime Minister John Major said Britain was set for sustained growth for "as far ahead as you can credibly judge".

Speaking after the publication of figures showing three percent growth over the last 12 months, Major told a Conservative news conference that "nobody can honestly say there is a sustained boom that is going to go on for ever."
But he added: "The British economy is set fair for sustained growth for as far ahead as you can credibly judge."
Major said the current rate of growth was not pushing inflation or wages up to unacceptable levels.
